learning_outcomes.text: Students learn methods and technical expertise to handle design tasks for complex and innovative machines and products.

syllabus_topics: Important components for complex machines (e.g., welding connections and gears)
Selection, design, and functional installation of machine components
Calculation methods for component design, dimensioning, and testing regarding function, strength, and service life
Definition of requirements for design tasks
Conception of moderately complex, innovative machines
Constructive design of moderately complex, innovative machines

assessment_methods.method: Graded written exam for Machine Elements 3
Non-graded semester-accompanying project work for Design Exercise 2

assessment_rules: The module grade is based on a 60-minute graded written exam for Machine Elements 3. A non-graded, semester-accompanying project work for Design Exercise 2 must be passed, but it does not contribute to the final module grade. Active participation in the project and milestone meetings, as well as submission of a final report, are mandatory for the project work.
bibliography: Wittel, H. et al.: Roloff/Matek Maschinenelemente – Normung, Berechnung, Gestaltung. Springer 2017
Pahl, G.; Beitz, W.: Konstruktionslehre – Methoden und Anwendung erfolgreicher Produktentwicklung. Springer 2013
